title: Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Week 11: Add Emari Demercado and Adonai Mitchell

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Fantasy Football Waiver Wire Week 11: Add Emari Demercado and Adonai Mitchell
sources.description: With Omar Cooper Jr. banged up, Adonai Mitchell is poised for a strong close to the fantasy regular season. Emari Demercado is taking over in Houston, putting him on FLEX radar as well.
